name: Native AWQ complete grid execution checkpoint
body:
This independent AMD FP16 AWQ adaptation now has a source-bound Lean proof of complete initialized grid execution and termination. It retains every K32 iteration, both native K16 passes, signed K control, guarded FP32-to-half output stores, the original scheduler and all original fuel limits. Both input matrices remain unchanged.

The source checker and standalone replay each pass 644 axiom audits across 62 owned modules and four complete source programs. Six altered sources fail on false source identity, and 62 fully rehashed scope controls fail before extraction. Only `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound` are allowed. No proof caps, shape bounds or fuel limits were raised. The wheel includes all 60 AWQ Lean resources byte for byte.

The archive contains source only, with no owned compiled cache. Asset: `awq-whole-grid-source-20261112.tar.gz`, 116,631 bytes, SHA256 `e75e7b1d1a4fddc0044b6ca18f0a6c75ef03f0f774f75558da2a7c3992545330`.

The proved execution boundary is `LarkMFMA.runGrid`. Whole-trace race freedom, complete output extraction and independent dense-reference equality remain unfinished. This checkpoint issues zero AWQ source certificates; eight independently adapted production families remain accepted. The authors' exact adapted PTX, original model pass rates/token costs and NVIDIA measurements are separate unreproduced results.

The existing paired numerical evidence remains 120 launches across `mi350` and `mi350-2`, 820,224 CPU float64 output comparisons, zero tolerance failures and zero cross-host FP16 bit differences. This proof checkpoint makes no model calls or GPU launches.
